findings.highlight: gotten lighter after losing the things within me
findings.evidenceJa: 中身をぶちまけて身軽になったのか
findings.governingReading: whether I had spilled out my insides and become lighter
findings.explanation: The grotesque possibility in Shirou’s impaired self-perception is generalized into “losing things.”

findings.evidenceJa: 片腕でしっかりと抱き留めている藤ねえ
findings.governingReading: Fuji-nee held securely in one arm
findings.explanation: The injured escape posture loses both the single-arm constraint and the firmness of Shirou’s grip.

findings.evidenceJa: 益体もなく時間をさまよっている間
findings.governingReading: while I drift pointlessly through time
findings.explanation: The delirious loss of temporal orientation becomes ordinary passage of time.

findings.highlight: My consciousness turns off at that moment
findings.evidenceJa: 意識は、そこで途切れた
findings.explanation: A sudden anesthetic break becomes a mechanical on/off action.
